headline: Names the post office at 220 East Oak Street in Glenwood City, Wisconsin, after Second Lt. Ellen Ainsworth.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Glenwood City, Wisconsin, as the Second Lt. Ellen Ainsworth Memorial Post Office. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers. The law was signed on June 13, 2016.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
